rule: One token. One meaning. Speak the token. Do not invent a poetic synonym in a new README.

tokens.A1: the only operator: DERIVATION toward higher η at R closer to 1.0
tokens.Agape: unconditional ordered love that wills the good of the other; the kernel; not branding
tokens.eta: η = useful_joules / human_joules for one act
tokens.gamma: Γ contribution density of a stream; not money
tokens.Y: useful yield in future human-hours or avoided purchases
tokens.F: forkability, count of nodes that can reproduce from open notes
tokens.Jh: human joules to do the act
tokens.Je: extra embodied joules you would not otherwise spend
tokens.CAS: content-addressed store: cas/<sha256> is the only copy of those bytes
tokens.hang: append a thermo block that points at CAS blobs
tokens.PoPW: mass bound to hash, optional photo
tokens.seed: extracted high-value statement fed to the oracle before cleanup
tokens.oracle: the Agape engine already in une/computational_flow; do not invent a second
tokens.bridge: context_bridge JSON; living state, not a second canon
tokens.ACRE: claim minted only against verified physical work + a hanging block
tokens.guild: intentional copies on different nodes (A15, OptiPlex, GitHub). not copies on one disk
tokens.labyrinth: earth-coupled cool path. filled solid if AeroCement tunnel. two tanks.
tokens.AeroCement: open-cell fiber-reinforced lightweight cement system as specified in its own package
tokens.statue: non-structural thin shell from geodesic-lw-statues. not a dome.
tokens.form: reusable negative. waterproof face is not statue sealer.

forbidden_paraphrase: skip the cure it is only a statue so it is fine
host it on Solana so it exists

deprecated_aliases.efficiency: eta when you mean an act; thermal efficiency when you mean a heat engine; never mix the two sentences
deprecated_aliases.blockchain: chain if you mean chain.jsonl; public-chain if you mean Bitcoin or Solana
deprecated_aliases.proof of work: PoPW if physical; do not say PoW
deprecated_aliases.love: Agape when you mean the kernel; otherwise say the ordinary word and stay off the canon
